t: This is Hotel Babylon, though not a real hotel. It was a British television drama that aired on BBC One from January 2006 to August 2009. It followed the lives of workers at a glamorous five-star hotel, and it was based on the 2004 book of the same name by Imogen Edwards-Jones. Carnival Films produced it. Tony Basgallop, a British screenwriter, is credited with making it. He is also known for writing Inside Men, What Remains, and Servant.
